# Operator coverage

Recorded over the full Python suite on an RX 5600M (RADV), 2026-07-28.

- operators declared: **65** (63 the executor can observe; 2 are leaves, whose values are supplied rather than computed)
- operators executed: **63 of 63**
- backends observed: cpu, vulkan
- backward rules declared: **47**, fired: **47**
- total node evaluations: 123,170

## BLOCKING — never executed

None. Every operator the executor can observe was executed at least once.

## BLOCKING — backward rules that never fired

None. Every declared backward rule was exercised.

## ORACLE — executed on one backend only

The correctness chain (`ARCHITECTURE.md` §7) is CPU-against-PyTorch for semantics, then Vulkan-against-CPU for kernel bugs. One backend breaks it.

| operator | ran on | missing |
|---|---|---|
| `prod` | cpu | **vulkan** |

## PATH — kernel paths never taken

**Never given a non-contiguous input.** Kernels index their sources through `operand_offset`; an operator that has only ever seen contiguous inputs has never run that arithmetic.

- `cast`
- `max_pool2d_backward`
- `slice_backward`

**Never run at a size crossing more than one workgroup** (>256 elements, the default in `vk_pipeline.h`). Single-group runs hide cross-group indexing errors.

None.
